_comment: EXAMPLE planted adverse event. Synthea never makes a drug cause anything, so planted events are the only true positives. Copy this block to add more. The answer key is never shown in the app; it is for checking the tool's output.

condition.objective_evidence: ALT 186 U/L (about 4x upper limit of normal) on 2022-04-12

symptoms.description: Pain in right upper quadrant of abdomen (finding)

answer.why: Liver enzymes rose 6 weeks after starting amiodarone and returned to normal about 5 weeks after it was stopped (positive dechallenge). Amiodarone's label warns of hepatic injury.
